Aaron (1958)** (Document 2, ID: 358_0001-01): This case involved the Little Rock school desegregation crisis, where the Governor of Arkansas attempted to prevent the integration of Little Rock Central High School. The Supreme Court held that federal court orders to integrate schools must be obeyed, affirming the principle of judicial supremacy and the rule of law in enforcing the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
